newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU central bank needs political guidance - Chirac.
newsitem.headline: EU central bank needs political guidance - Chirac.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac said on Thursday countries participating in a planned single European Union currency should form a "political institution" that would give guidance to the future European Central Bank.

"All those participating in the euro must form a government, that is to say a political power able to clearly define the limits of the monetary power's action, ask it to explain itself, exactly as it happens...in France, the United States or Germany.
"Central banks are independent...there must be a responsible political institution as a counterpart to the European Central Bank," Chirac said in a television interview.

"As a counterpart to the European Central Bank, there must be a responsible political institution. This responsible government, this responsible political institution, must simply be the European Council, naturally those inside the euro."

"By definition it is the power of the heads of state and government, the assembly of the heads of state and government, who get explanations and who give guidance to a monetary authority and which is there to effectively and accountably manage the currency," he said.
